Chapter 6688: Three-Lives Heaven Suppression Art

Chapter 6688: Three-lives Heaven Suppression Art

Zhan Sansheng was one of a kind. No other cultivator had duplicated his feat of becoming an immortal three times.

Spectators observed the three beings intensely. Although the three weren’t in their prime, they were still immortals.

The three auras differed dramatically. Moshi had a black flame with a hint of frenziness. Dingtian had the noblest immortal energy. As for Poye, his aura was the sharpest and most destructive.

The primordial battlefield, tough as it was, couldn’t contain all the rays inside as the three lives surrounded Evil Transformation and Fiendish Ground.

“What’s the meaning of this?” Evil Transformation’s expression darkened.

“We’re here to free you, seniors.” Weizhen said.

Despite this, others found something was off given the triangular formation.

“Weizhen wants to destroy them.” They understood the actual goal.

All of this time, these two redemption grounds have supported Supreme Heaven ever since Moshi’s era. Some believed that without them, Zhan Sansheng and Supreme Heaven wouldn’t have survived.

It appeared to be a one-way street since the two ancient immortals never asked for anything.

“You dare?!” Fiendish Ground roared thunderously.

“Three-lives Heaven Suppression Art!” Weizhen ignored this and summoned an immortal formation.

A light erupted deep within Supreme Heaven. Three separate pillars of light surged from three altars, aiming for the three avatars.

“Three-lives Heaven Suppression Art!” Members of Supreme Heaven chanted and sent their vitality and energy to the altars.

The abandoned shells seemed to be returning to life after the vitality boost. Their auras took on the form of wings.

“Heaven Suppression!” All three yelled together with their sect members.

A ring formed around them and smashed the two ancient immortals.

“Go!” The duo’s astral forms became larger as they tried to block the ring.

The impact horrified spectators. This could have destroyed Three Immortals in one shot.

The duo blocked it successfully but the lightning bolts within only became stronger. They illuminated the astral forms, making them look transparent.

“Ugh...” Some bolts pierced their body and even their true fate, causing them to grow numb.

More bolts emerged like roots, not stopping for a single second. Alas, they remained standing.

“What are you waiting for?! Now is the time!” Weizhen ordered.

Listeners didn’t know who he was talking to because who else could join this battle?

“Go!” Two voices echoed across the battlefield.

“Primal Yin Immortal Ghost and Bao Pu!” Others recognized them.

The two were outside the battlefield not long ago but left silently. Everyone else focused on the nonstop events and didn’t keep an eye on them.
